facts.value: The Refugee and Migrant Health Partnership (RMHP) is offering six bursaries for migrants to undertake the Postgraduate Diploma in Participatory Health Research at University of Limerick's School of Medicine.
facts.programme_association: Postgraduate Diploma in Participatory Health Research

facts.value: A person who has been through the International Protection process; a Beneficiary of Temporary Protection; a work visa holder; or a member of the Roma community.
facts.programme_association: Postgraduate Diploma in Participatory Health Research
Postgraduate Diploma in Participatory Health Research

facts.value: Part-time, online with one in-person training block on-campus each semester.
facts.programme_association: Postgraduate Diploma in Participatory Health Research

facts.value: A Letter of Interest (maximum 3 A4 pages) outlining eligibility, confirmation of meeting programme eligibility requirements, and interest in Participatory Health Research.

facts.value: Letters of Interest will be reviewed by Course Director Prof. Jon Salsberg, RMHP UL lead Prof. Anne MacFarlane, and two migrant representatives from the Refugee and Migrant Health Partnership.

facts.value: Successful bursary applicants will also be required to apply directly to the programme.
